LESSON: TEMPERATURE

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven
Subject: GRADE
Strand: MEASUREMENTS
Topic 3.6: Temperature
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Temperature, part of MEASUREMENTS in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade seven GRADE.

Key inquiry question: How does temperature affect our everyday lives? 2. How do we measure temperature?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Temperature together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: Supports others in a group activity; as the learner works in groups and uses

tools of measuring temperature.

● Digital literacy: Using digital devices; as the learner determines the temperature of different places using digital

devices.

Values

● Responsibility: As the learner carefully handles tools of measuring temperature.

● Integrity: As the learner gives correct measurements of temperature.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of temperature in Mathematics to body temperatures in Health Education And
